"A long continous cinematic camera shot of a whimsical 3D cartoony animation set in a secluded natural environment with a mountain view and a setting sun. An old man wearing a hat riding on top of a cute and large hippo wearing a scarf swiftly move along a curvy dirt and rocky path. The hippo playfully charges along the path, pouncing up and down as it kicks up a plume of dirt cloud in it's wake while moving towards camera, while the camera dollies back and tracks the motion. The two are isolated in nature with no other in sight.\nThe environment features trees with fall-colored orange leaves, scattered orange bushes, several large gray boulders, and a winding dirt path that meanders through the landscape."
